ground_truth_recall_audit.milestone: Dropped support for Python 3.8 and raised the minimum dependency versions to the latest feature releases
Added a configuration option to control whether Flask automatically answers OPTIONS requests
Flask.open_resource, open_instance_resource and Blueprint.open_resource take an encoding parameter for text mode
Request.max_content_length can be customized per request instead of only through the MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH config
Added support for the Partitioned cookie attribute through the SESSION_COOKIE_PARTITIONED config
Changed .env loading so that -e path takes precedence over the default .env and .flaskenv files
Added secret key rotation with the SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS config
Fixed how host_matching=True and subdomain_matching=False interact with SERVER_NAME
Request.trusted_hosts is now checked during routing and can be set through the TRUSTED_HOSTS config

narrative_precision_audit.narrative_claim: significant update to the GitHub Actions workflows, specifically in the publish.yaml and tests.yaml files
bumping the versions of several actions, such as actions/setup-python from v5.1.0 to v5.1.1
a more comprehensive update was made to the CI/CD workflows
updates to the requirements files, indicating a broader strategy to maintain a healthy and modern development environment
updates to libraries such as pytest, mypy, and cryptography
continuous cycle of updating dependencies demonstrates a commitment to leveraging improvements and fixes
updates to the pre-commit configuration files
pre-commit hooks were updated from v0.6.2 to v0.7.0 and subsequently to v0.7.1
Each update, whether it be a minor version bump or a more significant overhaul, contributes to a more robust and maintainable codebase
